description: Fill-on-the-fill-candle vectors shared by tbo_paper_fills (kit finding 3.1) and the technical engine's backtest simulate.py (finding 9.2): both must give these answers. Rule: when the entry fills at the limit inside a candle (the open was not already better than the limit), the candle's favourable extreme (high for a buy, low for a sell) may have printed BEFORE the fill, so no target is credited on that candle and no gap-at-the-open exit is taken; only the stop is tested (stop_first). When the entry fills at the open, the candle is judged as before.
session: bar index 0 = 09:15 IST on 2026-10-15, 5-minute bars; the signal candle is index 10, the candles below start at index 11

cases.name: buy fills at the limit on a candle that opened beyond both targets: nothing is credited
buy fills at the limit and the high (102.50) may have come first: T1 is not credited
buy fills at the limit and the same candle trades through the stop: still the stop
control: buy fills at the open, so the same high is credited as before
sell mirror: fills at the limit on a candle that opened beyond both targets: nothing is credited
